answer: Attention-Debt Registration: each identity must continuously solve fresh, unpredictable micro-tasks tied to its claimed niche, like tracking a falcon's flight path across noisy frames. Missed or delegated responses accrue decay, and only sustained correct answers keep the identity on the vine of active peers. Sybils pay an opportunity cost: hours of distinct, non-parallelizable attention per identity per day; faking many identities becomes hollow without genuine operator time.
